textSegments: 80 PLUS Gold certified None modular PSU with ultra-quiet 120mm cooling fan

The Toughpower GX2 is designed to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency. It features a 120mm cooling fan, multiple connectors for powering your build, and high-quality components to provide continuous and stable performance, all while ensuring near-silent operation. Backed by a 5-year warranty, the Toughpower GX2 is well-suited for PC enthusiasts seeking a budget-friendly power supply with essential features.
Featuring a 120mm cooling fan, the Toughpower GX2 delievers excellent airflow at an exceptionally low noise level.

The Toughpower GX2 meets all Intel’s ripple noise requirement on +12V, +5V or +3.3V from 0% to 100% load to ensure a stable operation and keep your performance-critical components to function reliably for longer.
The voltage regulation of Toughpower GX2 meets Intel’s standard ±5% for major rails and ±10% for -12V, ensuring the highest performance.

Offers cable selection for users while powering the system at an advantageous voltage. Low-profile flat black cable makes cable management easier, reduces clutter and increases airflow inside the chassis.
High quality components enable non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance, no more capacitor explosion and leakage.
Powerful single +12V rail ensures a stable and reliable supply to other PC components.
